name: The Coral Gardener of Abyssal Depths
description: A gentle deep-sea creature tending to a vibrant garden of bioluminescent coral and sea fans, surrounded by schools of tiny glowing fish in the dark ocean depths.
prompt: A large deep-sea creature with tentacles carefully tending to glowing bioluminescent coral garden, schools of small luminescent fish swimming around, dark blue abyssal environment with ethereal blue and green lights, ultra-detailed marine life, photorealistic underwater scene
caption: In the deepest darkness, beauty blooms. Meet the guardian of the abyssal garden. 🌊✨
